stage0088a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$エンジェル$$...!
　If you can see $$ビッグオー$$, come out!
　I want to talk with you!」

stage0088a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
Military Police
「That black Megadeus... what is it doing?」

stage0088a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ダストン$$
「I don't know.
　But let him do as he likes.」

stage0088a_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ダストン$$
（$$ロジャー$$...
　I believe in your pride.）

stage0088a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, Master $$ロジャー$$... will it go well?」

stage0088a_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So you've come out, the Big!
　Proxy of the System!」

stage0088a_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「She says she doesn't want to see you,
　$$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0088a_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$...!」

stage0088a_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Yes... this legion of the Big
　is her will to refuse.」

stage0088a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see...
　So this is her answer, in place of words...」

stage0088a_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then removing it by force can be
　called a proper negotiation.」

stage0088a_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$桂$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, Mister Negotiator.」

stage0088a_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$モーム$$
「Shall we get to work, $$ロジャー$$?」

stage0088a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$宗介$$
「Crushing that legion, is it...
　But that logic just now seems forced.」

stage0088a_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「There is nothing in my heart to be ashamed of.
　Therefore, you are not guilty.」

stage0088a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't really get it,
　but this way suits us better.」

stage0088a_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$タケル$$
「So to escape Paradigm City,
　we have to defeat that legion, right?」

stage0088a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「When you get down to it, yes.」

stage0088a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But be careful.
　In '《$$メトロポリス$$》', the Big is said to have
　burned every world as a legion of god.」

stage0088a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$葵$$
「I've gotten used to that type of opponent lately.」

stage0088a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I wonder, can you all manage it?」

stage0088a_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$シン$$, $$バナージ$$...
　Don't think about anything unnecessary now.」

stage0088a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$n
「$$ガドライト$$ must be watching our fight...」

stage0088a_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$n
「I can't afford to lose in front of him...!」

stage0088a_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Now then, everyone...!
　Join me a while, before the truth comes to light!」

stage0088a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Witness the end of a pitiful man, possessed
　by an endless dream of the world's truth...!」

stage0088a_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$...!」

stage0088a_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Now, let's begin!
　...no, let's end it!」

stage0088a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「The world will soon be reborn!
　The end itself is the gateway to a new world!」

stage0088a_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アルト$$
「Does this mean we can go back to our world now?」

stage0088a_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not it.
　It's the other party in my negotiation.」

stage0088a_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$桂$$
「Watch out, $$ロジャー$$!
　It's coming again!」

stage0088a_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Guess it's a battle of patience now!」

stage0088a_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$スザク$$
「Wait!
　Something else is coming out!」

stage0088a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「A negative existence...
　One that does not belong to this world.」

stage0088a_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Hahaha!
　So you've finally... come!」

stage0088a_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「See you, $n...
　This is the answer she reached at despair's end.」

stage0088a_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「...Oh, but if it's farewell,
　I'll have to say it to this whole world.」

stage0088a_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's not a retreat...!
　That is... annihilation!」

stage0088a_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So that's the power of that colorless $$ビッグオー$$...!」

stage0088a_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ビッグヴィヌス$$...
　A bird stripped of its wings...」

stage0088a_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A beast, before its evolution into a bird...」

stage0088a_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$エンジェル$$...
　So you're the one piloting it.」

stage0088a_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I came here to talk with you.」

stage0088a_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Are you saying you won't listen?」

stage0088a_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$五飛$$
「If we let it run free, this city will be erased!」

stage0088a_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「And if it were to appear in our world too...!」

stage0088a_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If that happens...!
　The world would...!」

stage0088a_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Something someone prepared
　to reset the world's existence...）

stage0088a_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Are you saying that when the 12,000-year
　cycle closes, it means to grant the despairing
　peace in the name of nothingness...!）

stage0088a_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$赤木$$
「What'll you do, $$ロジャー$$!
　Use your usual trick!?」

stage0088a_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But that's merely one step toward negotiation.」

stage0088a_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We'll leave the finish to you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$キラ$$
「Come to think of it, this happened before.」

stage0088a_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$シン$$
「We managed it back then too!
　And this time as well...!」

stage0088a_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But it has the power to erase our existence...!」

stage0088a_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$隼人$$
「Mere contact isn't the issue...!
　If it turns its attention to us, we're erased!」

stage0088a_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So dodging or toughing out its attacks
　makes no difference either way!」

stage0088a_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「In other words, each of us gets
　only one chance to attack!」

stage0088a_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Regardless of the outcome, anyone
　who fights it will be erased!」

stage0088a_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「It's not annihilation.
　Our existence is only held in another dimension.」

stage0088a_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「A kind of quantum theory...!」

stage0088a_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Don't quite get it, but we won't die, huh!」

stage0088a_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ロジャー$$ will surely bring your existence back.」

stage0088a_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So whether we exist depends on his negotiation.」

stage0088a_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$桂$$
「I trust your skill at the negotiating table.」

stage0088a_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$ブライト$$
「All units!
　Each of you gets only one chance to attack!
　Dodging or blocking changes nothing!」

stage0088a_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Pour every unit's firepower into
　that $$ビッグヴィヌス$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「$$ロジャー$$...
　You alone should be spared from annihilation.」

stage0088a_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「So $$ビッグオー$$ and I become the last trump card.」

stage0088a_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm counting on you, everyone...!
　Lend me your strength, to bring
　her to the negotiating table!」

stage0088a_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$甲児$$
「But in exchange, we'll count on you for the finish!」

stage0088a_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then here we go, $$エンジェル$$!
　Such a tasteless outfit doesn't suit you!」

stage0088a_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Here I come! $$エンジェル$$!!」

stage0088a_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
???
「Fate does not change.
　Not by human hands.」

stage0088a_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$エンジェル$$!
　Can you hear my voice!」

stage0088a_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I won't ask what drove you to despair!」

stage0088a_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's all in the past now.
　The memory... and this city's birth too.」

stage0088a_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「This city is an illusion named eternity...
　And so are we, who live here...」

stage0088a_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If you're tired of dreaming, just wake up.
　Reality isn't so bad after all.」

stage0088a_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What's lost, be it the past or memory, won't return.
　No, maybe none of it ever existed at all.」

stage0088a_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But the here and now surely exists.
　Yes... this world you feel right now
　is an undeniable truth.」

stage0088a_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「This city's the same way.
　...It doesn't matter who built it, or how.
　Paradigm City is alive.」

stage0088a_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「And the world stretches out endlessly.
　If you don't like the role you've been handed,
　just step off the stage on your own.」

stage0088a_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But... I have nowhere to go,
　and neither do the people of this city...」

stage0088a_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just ask your own feet.
　Go wherever the wind takes you, wherever your heart
　takes you, and that will be your destination.」

stage0088a_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Outside the dome might be wasteland.
　But it's up to you to see for yourself
　what lies beyond it.」

stage0088a_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「And what if there's nothing there either?」

stage0088a_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then create something with your own hands.」

stage0088a_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The past's gone, but you can still build the future...
　If you don't like the role someone chose for you,
　then decide your own role yourself.」

stage0088a_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Just as I chose my role
　as the world's negotiator.」

stage0088a_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If that's what you want, come with us.」

stage0088a_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Do I even have the right to that?」

stage0088a_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I told you already.
　That's for you to decide.」

stage0088a_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The wings you think you've lost
　must still be in your heart.」

stage0088a_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Spread those folded wings, $$エンジェル$$.
　You're free.」

stage0088a_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Quite poetic, for you.
　Though a bit old-fashioned.」

stage0088a_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Isn't that refreshing, though?
　In that sense, the past isn't so bad.」

stage0088a_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「That's true...
　At the very least, the time I spent with you
　was irreplaceable to me.」

stage0088a_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Even if someone else decided that for me.」

stage0088a_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then, from now on, let's build that time with me...
　no, with everyone who hopes for a future.」

stage0088a_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Heh... not saying 'the two of us together'
　makes for a failed pick-up line.」

stage0088a_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「But it wasn't bad.
　$$ロジャー$$, the Negotiator...」

stage0088a_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Thank you...
　I... I'll accept this world.」

stage0088a_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$エンジェル$$
「Let's meet again, $$ロジャー$$.
　Somewhere, in some corner of the world.」

stage0088a_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'll be looking forward to that day.」

stage0088a_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ビッグデュオ$$, $$ビッグファウ$$... and $$ビッグオー$$...
　Every type, taken down.」

stage0088a_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Without a Dominus in the cockpit,
　even the Big is no match
　for me and $$ビッグオー$$.」

stage0088a_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Is it time for the finale, then!」

stage0088a_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツバルト$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Soon, you'll all learn the truth of this world!
　Yes...! The existence of the one who governs fate!」

stage0088a_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「I'm satisfied, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　The Big's advent, the world's end, the System's
　activation, I saw them all with my own eyes!」

stage0088a_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Still caught up in illusions, are you...!」

stage0088a_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「Then, let's give him an ending
　fitting for the Big's Dominus.」

stage0088a_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$ドロシー#240$$... if you've come, that means...」

stage0088a_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ドロシー#240$$
「I'm releasing $$ビッグオー$$'s final seal.」

stage0088a_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$シュバルツ$$!
　I'll put an end to your quest for the truth!」

stage0088a_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Ha ha ha! Ha ha ha ha ha!
　To think the last sight I'd see
　wouldn't be flames, but light!」

stage0088a_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「But this isn't bad!
　Not bad at all!」

stage0088a_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$...!
　In the end, you chose to live
　without being bound by memory.」

stage0088a_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's not me turning away from your 'truth'.
　I simply never found value in memory... in the past.」

stage0088a_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「What I want isn't the past.
　It's the future.」

stage0088a_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Hmph... a reporter can't write tomorrow's news.
　From here on, see the truth for yourself.」

stage0088a_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「Farewell, $$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　Paint the future with your negotiations!」

stage0088a_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$桂$$
「Noisy to the very end, that guy.」

stage0088a_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But he lived life his own way, to the end.
　That deserves respect.」

stage0088a_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ロジャー$$
（Farewell, $$シュバルツバルト$$.
　Rest, this time for real.）

stage0088a_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「$$ロジャー$$...!
　I'm entrusting the world's survival to you!」

stage0088a_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The Quarter...!
　Is it going to disappear!?」

stage0088a_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$號$$
「My... my very existence! Is it disappearing!」

stage0088a_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$オットー$$
「I-it's really disappearing!
　The $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ is vanishing!」

stage0088a_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「So this is the power that erases the world...!」

stage0088a_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is as far as I go!
　I'm counting on you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$さやか$$
「I'm disappearing!
　Venus and I are both disappearing!」

stage0088a_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$ボス$$
「Whoaaaargh!
　We're really about to disappear!」

stage0088a_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Count on you, $$ロジャー$$!
　If I, the president, vanish, my company's done for!」

stage0088a_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$柿小路$$
「T-this won't d～o!
　I can't disappear and leave my family behind...!」

stage0088a_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$隼人$$
「My body's being wrapped in light...!」

stage0088a_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn it!
　I knew it was coming, but it's worse than I imagined!」

stage0088a_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$葵$$
「Even I'm at a loss here...
　The rest is up to the negotiator's skill.」

stage0088a_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$タケル$$
「I've done everything I could.
　Now it's up to Mr. $$ロジャー$$.」

stage0088a_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「N-no good!
　The $$コスモクラッシャー$$'s vanishing!」

stage0088a_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$赤木$$
「Hang in there, $$ダイ・ガード$$!
　Grit and guts, just hold on somehow...」

stage0088a_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Father... maybe, after this,
　I'll never get to see you again...）

stage0088a_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$アスカ$$
「N-no way! We're really disappearing!?
　Me and Unit-02, both of us!!」

stage0088a_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$マリ$$
「Haha... you don't get an experience like this every day...」

stage0088a_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$シモン$$
「I believe in you, $$ロジャー$$!
　That you'll save us and the world!」

stage0088a_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キタン$$
「Daaaaamn it!!
　Isn't there anything we can dooooo!!」

stage0088a_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Wh-what is this!
　What's happening to my body!」

stage0088a_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「I-I don't want to think about it, but
　if we really vanish like this...」

stage0088a_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$ロジャー$$!
　I believe you can make a miracle happen!」

stage0088a_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$アルト$$
「If I can never see her again like this,
　then I...!」

stage0088a_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Well... I knew this might happen, but
　it's still not a pleasant feeling...」

stage0088a_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$ルカ$$
「I-if I knew it'd come to this,
　I'd have spent more time with Nanase...!」

stage0088a_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$クラン$$
「$$ミシェル$$!
　I'm...! The way I feel about you is...」

stage0088a_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カナリア$$
「Eddie...
　If anything happens... live strong, okay...」

stage0088a_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アマタ$$
「Aquarion!
　It's vanishing from this world!」

stage0088a_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$桂$$
「Well then... guess I'll leave the rest
　to $$ロジャー$$-sensei...!」

stage0088a_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ガムリン$$
「T-this is as far as I go!
　$$ガムリン・木崎$$, disappearing!」

stage0088a_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Whoaaaa!
　I haven't sung nearly enough yet!!」

stage0088a_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't let it end before I learn her true intentions...!」

stage0088a_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$リディ$$
「Am I... just a man who ends here!
　No, that can't be...!」

stage0088a_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$カツ$$
「N-no! I don't want this!
　I don't want this at all!!」

stage0088a_04:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I won't let it end before I face him!
　I'm counting on you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「N-no, not like this!
　$$クェス$$...! $$クェス$$!!」

stage0088a_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Swallowed... by the light!
　$$オードリー$$!!」

stage0088a_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ダグザ$$
「Even if I vanish, the soul of Echoes will never die!」

stage0088a_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$シン$$
「Daaaaamn it!!
　Is there nothing I can do!」

stage0088a_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$ロジャー$$!
　I entrust the world's future to you!」

stage0088a_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Tch... the reaper's wrapped in light, off to heaven.
　Not exactly a cool way to go...」

stage0088a_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$トロワ$$
「...So this is what disappearing feels like...
　I see...」

stage0088a_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$カトル$$
「The world... it mustn't be swallowed by this light...!
　$$ロジャー$$, I'm counting on you!」

stage0088a_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$五飛$$
「I've done all I can; the rest is up to Heaven...
　The rest, I leave to you, $$ロジャー・スミス$$.」

stage0088a_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Dying doesn't scare me...
　But going without seeing where the world ends up... that I regret...」

stage0088a_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$ノイン$$
「This light is what erases the world...!?」

stage0088a_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「I'm disappearing...!
　Am I really going to disappear!?」

stage0088a_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　She surely must... to you...」

stage0088a_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Since I knew, there's no point freaking out about it.
　...The rest's up to you, Mister Negotiator.」

stage0088a_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
「Seriously!? This is nuts!
　This has gotta be a scam!」

stage0088a_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「So this is the System's power...
　Can humanity really... defeat something like this...」

stage0088a_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$マオ$$
「Quite the rare experience, this...
　Let's hope we can laugh about it later.」

stage0088a_04:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$クルツ$$
「W-wait, hold on!
　I'm not mentally prepared for thiiiis!!」

stage0088a_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$宗介$$
「Chidori... I will return, without fail...」

stage0088a_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I've done everything I could...
　Now I'll trust in our allies' efforts.」

stage0088a_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$!
　I'm wagering the world on your professional pride!」

stage0088a_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$スザク$$
「Even if this is as far as I go,
　$c isn't finished yet!
　I'm counting on you for the rest!」

stage0088a_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$カレン$$
「I can't let this world end just yet!
　I'm counting on you, $$ロジャー$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Even I have no way to stop this...」

stage0088a_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$キリコ$$
（The rest, I leave to you, $$ロジャー$$.）

stage0088a_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Is this too a power beyond the ordinary...」

stage0088a_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$グラハム$$
「My comrades will carry on my will...!
　The rest, I leave to you!」

stage0088a_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「W-wait, wait!
　I'm the Undying $$コーラサワー$$... no, wait,
　now it's the Happy Cola...」

stage0088a_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$n
「I understand now...!
　This power too... it's part of the $$次元力$$...」

stage0088a_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「We've known each other a good long while now,
　$$シュバルツバルト$$!」

stage0088a_04:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「But that will soon come to an end!
　And then, the truth will be dragged
　into the light of day!」

stage0088a_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シュバルツ$$
「And humanity will despair!
　Upon learning this world's true form!」

stage0088a_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see.
　So you're the one who tasted despair
　a step ahead of everyone else.」

stage0088a_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「But there's no need to worry!
　We've overcome despair again and again
　to get to where we are now!」

stage0088a_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Don't shut your heart away in loneliness!
　You're not alone!」

stage0088a_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「You too are one of the people who make up this world!
　Yes... please understand
　this world isn't yours alone!」

stage0088a_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$n
（$$ガドライト$$...!
　I will never forget today's humiliation...!
　And I'll make you regret underestimating us...!）

stage0088a_04:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$n
（We will surely find the singularity,
　and shatter your scheme...!）

stage0088a_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$n
（$$ガドライト・メオンサム$$!
　I'll make you regret this, without fail!）

stage0088a_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The Black History...
　We should have avoided that...）

stage0088a_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But $$シュバルツ$$ said that Nuclear Winter
　was brought about by $$シャア$$'s own hand...）

stage0088a_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アムロ$$
（What is this chill...!
　What on earth has happened to the world...!）
